key.name: db_mask
key.description: use the specified filtering algorithm from BLAST DB

key.name: idmap
key.description: generate id map for the sequences in the index

key.name: iformat
key.description: type of input used (default is "blastdb" for new style index, "fasta" for old style index)

key.name: legacy
key.description: use legacy (0-terminated offset lists) dbindex format

key.name: logfile
key.description: File to which the program log should be redirected

key.name: stat
key.description: write index statistics into file with that name (for testing and debugging purposes only).

key.name: volsize
key.description: size of an index volume in MB

key.name: ws_hint
key.description: most likely word size used in searches

flag.name: dryrun
flag.description: Dry run the application: do nothing, only test all preconditions

flag.name: h
flag.description: Print USAGE and DESCRIPTION; ignore all other parameters

flag.name: help
flag.description: Print USAGE, DESCRIPTION and ARGUMENTS; ignore all other parameters

flag.name: show_filters
flag.description: show the info about available database filtering algorithms and exit

flag.name: version
flag.description: Print version number; ignore other arguments

flag.name: version-full
flag.description: Print extended version data; ignore other arguments

flag.name: version-full-json
flag.description: Print extended version data in JSON format; ignore other arguments

flag.name: version-full-xml
flag.description: Print extended version data in XML format; ignore other arguments

flag.name: xmlhelp
flag.description: Print USAGE, DESCRIPTION and ARGUMENTS in XML format; ignore all other parameters
